allowed_current_claim: Paper 8 found HCP WM measured physiology files and ran an 18-subject measured-physiology ladder smoke, but the preregistered raw SameTransition > DifferentTransition gate was not reproduced. No physiological-survival claim is allowed.

ds005795_extension.allowed_claim: The ds005795 extension has a three-subject BOLD/physiology/metadata interface smoke. It does not establish physiology-robust transition dynamics.
ds005795_extension.role: convergent measured-physiology validation, not direct Encode/Maintain/Probe replication

ds005795_streaming_extension.allowed_claim: The ds005795 streaming extension completed all manifest-available learning subjects with complete BOLD/physio/events files. It shows physiology regressors improve global-signal prediction in this convergent task, but it does not rescue the failed HCP primary transition-reproducibility gate.
ds005795_streaming_extension.claim_boundary: This is a convergent ds005795 measured-physiology nuisance-ladder analysis over global BOLD signal. It is not a direct HCP working-memory transition replication and does not rescue the failed P8 HCP primary gate.
ds005795_streaming_extension.role: convergent measured-physiology nuisance-ladder analysis over global BOLD signal; not direct Encode/Maintain/Probe replication

e1_e6_raw_reproduction_preflight.claim_boundary: The HCP measured-physiology ladder cannot be regenerated from raw CIFTI inputs in this environment because matched large HCP dtseries/dlabel/EV/motion files are incomplete locally. Existing result artifacts may be used for package assembly, but this step is not a fresh raw-data rerun.

ladder_scope: 18-subject / 36-run HCP-YA WM measured-physiology smoke using available downloaded Physio_log files; not full Paper 8 final.
